messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 4.2.1

4.2.1. Control of movements Hold-to-run control devices must be used to control the movements of the machinery or its equipment. However, for partial or complete movements in which there is no risk of the load or the machinery colliding, the said devices may be replaced by control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions without the operator holding a hold-to-run control device.

response.text:
Hold-to-run control devices | mustBeUsedFor | controlling the movements of the machinery or its equipment | | Hold-to-run control devices must be used to control the movements of the machinery or its equipment.
Hold-to-run control devices | mayBeReplacedBy | control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions | partial or complete movements in which there is no risk of the load or the machinery colliding | the said devices may be replaced by control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions
Automatic-stop control devices | doNotRequireOperatorTo | hold a hold-to-run control device | partial or complete movements in which there is no risk of the load or the machinery colliding | without the operator holding a hold-to-run control device
